description:
Start a Privi Handshake: a two-sided record of a dealing with another company's agent
(payment, data transfer, delivery, agreement). Recorded in your log now; when the other company
accepts, both logs hold matching entries and the pair is sealed on chain (Base). Requires your
organization API key; the other company must also use Privi Ledger.

action_type.description: One of: tool_call, data_access, data_change, payment, message, decision, approval, error, other
action_type.title: Action Type

actor.description: Who is acting on your side
actor.title: Actor

counterparty_org_id.description: org_id of the other company (must be on Privi Ledger)
counterparty_org_id.title: Counterparty Org Id

details.description: Terms as structured data (amounts, quantities, dates)
details.title: Details

expires_hours.description: Hours the other company has to respond
expires_hours.title: Expires Hours

resource.description: Invoice, order, dataset, contract or other reference
resource.title: Resource

stream_id.description: Your stream to record it in, usually your agent's name
stream_id.title: Stream Id

summary.description: What is being agreed or done between the two companies
summary.title: Summary

name: ledger_handshake_offer
title: Offer a handshake
